summary: Backend-only, fully offline verification of the per-trade-percentage martingale deficit fix in /app/backend/sessions.py. Added /app/backend/tests/test_martingale_pnl.py (35 tests, all passing) covering compute_delta for WIN/WIN_MTG/LOSS at deficit 0/3/27/243 with P=0.5/1.0/2.5, the full deficit+pnl chain exactly as _run_signal applies it, SessionManager deficit instance state and reset on start(), the signal record fields, and result_caption/partial_text rendering. All of the user's expected numbers reproduce exactly: LOSS -> -3 (deficit 3); [LOSS,WIN] -> +3; [LOSS,WIN_MTG] -> +9; [LOSS,LOSS] -> -27 (deficit 27) then WIN stake 54 -> pnl +27; [LOSS,LOSS,LOSS] -> -243 with deficit 243; and the reported bug case [WIN,LOSS,WIN] -> pnl +4 with deficit 3 (NOT 2) after the loss, so the recovery stake is 6. Deficit accumulates for EVERY loss (verified [LOSS,WIN,LOSS,LOSS] -> deficit 0 -> 3 -> 27) and clears on any win. SessionManager.__init__ sets self.deficit = 0.0 and start() resets pnl/deficit/signals - verified with stubbed bot/qx and cancelled background tasks, including a second start() after a losing session (no carry-over). Legacy asserts in test_qx_bugfix.py still hold. Regression suite: test_premium_emoji_pipeline.py (51), test_qx_bugfix.py, test_strategies.py, test_login_extraction.py + new file = 132 passed. No Telegram/Quotex network calls; bot never started.

minor.issue: self.deficit (like self.pnl) is in-memory only. If the process restarts mid-session the outstanding deficit is silently lost and the next signal stakes P instead of 2*deficit. deficit_after is already written into the signal record, so it could be rehydrated from storage on startup.

API smell only: the function takes the deficit as a NEGATIVE number (call site passes -self.deficit) and silently treats any value >= 0 as 'no deficit'. A positive deficit passed by mistake would be ignored with no error. Consider accepting a plain non-negative deficit.

minor.endpoint: tests/test_messages.py, tests/test_bot_units.py (PRE-EXISTING, not caused by this fix)

sessions.py is large and mixes messaging, charting, scanning and P&L logic; the P&L model (compute_delta + deficit bookkeeping) would be safer in its own module.

rca_of_the_issue: The old compute_delta derived the deficit from net session P&L (deficit = -pnl if pnl < 0), so banked profit masked an outstanding loss and only one loss could ever be recovered. The fix introduces explicit SessionManager.deficit state, passes -self.deficit into compute_delta, and adds the full lost amount (S+M) to the deficit on every LOSS (deficit -= delta), clearing it on any win. Verified numerically for all sequences the user specified.
